Read data

```{r}

folder = "trees/2024_11_29_12_00"   
fileName = paste(base_folder, folder,"SummaryIndividuals.csv",sep="/")

world = whole_world

colors = rgb(world$speed/max(world$speed), world$maxEnergy/max(world$maxEnergy), world$kidEnergy/max(world$kidEnergy))

close3d()

```

```{r}
world = whole_world[the_sample,]
```

Do PCA over time!

```{r}
t = 0
max_t = max(world$created)
step_size = 500
pc1 = c()
pc2 = c()
pc_t <- data.frame(Ints=integer(), Doubles=double(), Doubles=double())
colnames(pc_t) = c("created", "pc1", "pc2")

while (t < max_t) {
  part_world = subset(world, (world$created>=t) & (world$created<t+step_size))
  pc <- prcomp(part_world[c("pgmDeath","maxEnergy", "speed", "kidEnergy", "nkids", "matForKids")], #"sensors", 
             center = TRUE,
            scale. = TRUE)
  
  temp_df = data.frame(part_world$created, pc$x[,1], pc$x[,2])
  colnames(temp_df) = c("created", "pc1", "pc2")
  pc_t = rbind(pc_t, temp_df)
  
  plot(pc$x[,1],pc$x[,2],main=t)
  
  t = t + step_size
} 
```


```{r}
t=53000
part_world = subset(world, (world$created>=t) & (world$created<t+step_size))
pc <- prcomp(part_world[c("pgmDeath","maxEnergy", "speed", "kidEnergy", "nkids", "matForKids")], #"sensors", 
           center = TRUE,
          scale. = TRUE)

projected = predict(pc, world[c("pgmDeath","maxEnergy", "speed", "kidEnergy", "nkids", "matForKids")])

plot(projected[,1])
plot(projected[,2])
plot(projected[,3])

```

Number of agents

```{r}
t = 0
max_t = max(world$created)
step_size = 100
n_agents_t <- data.frame(Ints=integer(), Ints=integer())
colnames(n_agents_t) = c("t", "n")

while (t < max_t) {
  part_world = subset(world, (world$created>=t) & (world$created<t+step_size))
  n_agents_t = rbind(n_agents_t, c(t, length(part_world$created)))
  t = t + step_size
} 

colnames(n_agents_t) = c("t", "n")

plot(n_agents_t, type = "l", main="Number of agents")

```

Read predation data

```{r}

# folder = "2024_11_07_19_38" 
fileName = paste(base_folder, folder,"predation.csv",sep="/")

interactions <- read.csv(fileName, stringsAsFactors=F, dec =".", header=TRUE, row.names=NULL)

l = length(interactions$t) # step in sim and in this are not ok
interactions$int_id = c(1:l)
sub_interactions = interactions
max_t = max(sub_interactions$t)
print(max_t)
```

```{r}
hist(sub_interactions$successful)

early = subset(sub_interactions, t<(max_t/2))
late = subset(sub_interactions, t>=(max_t/2))

hist(early$successful)
hist(late$successful)
```



```{r}
sub_interactions = subset(interactions, t>30000)
```

Histograms ftw

```{r}
success_eat = subset(sub_interactions, successful>0)
fail_eat =  subset(sub_interactions, successful<0)

hist(success_eat$prey_sensors)
hist(success_eat$prey_maxEnergy)
hist(success_eat$prey_nkids)

```

```{r}
sub_success_eat = subset(success_eat, success_eat$prey_maxEnergy>6)

significant_counts = as.data.frame(table(sub_success_eat$pred_id), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
hist(significant_counts$Freq)

# significant_counts = subset(significant_counts, significant_counts$Freq > 1)
significant_counts$pred_id = as.integer(significant_counts$Var1)
```

```{r}
significant_interactions = subset(sub_success_eat, pred_id %in% significant_counts$pred_id)

pred_percent = c()
time = 0
step_size = 1000
while (time < max_t) {
  sig = subset(significant_interactions, (t > time) & (t <= (time+step_size)))
  all = subset(success_eat, (t > time) & (t <= (time+step_size)))
  pred_percent = c(pred_percent, length(sig$t)/length(all$t))
  
  time = time + step_size
}

# print(length(significant_interactions$t)/length(success_eat$t))

plot(pred_percent*100)

predation = data.frame(pred_percent)
predation$t = seq(min(interactions$t), max_t, by=step_size)
# predation$t = c(0,seq(min(interactions$t), max_t, by=step_size))

```

```{r}
factor = max(world$speed) - min(world$speed)
plot(x = world$created, y=world$speed, main = folder)
points(predation$t, predation$pred_percent*factor + min(world$speed), type = "l", col="red")

factor = max(world$sensors) - min(world$sensors)
plot(x = world$created, y=world$sensors, main = folder)
points(predation$t, predation$pred_percent*factor + min(world$sensors), type = "l", col="red")

factor = max(world$kidEnergy) - min(world$kidEnergy)
plot(x = world$created, y=world$kidEnergy, main = folder)
points(predation$t, predation$pred_percent*factor + min(world$kidEnergy), type = "l", col="red")

factor = max(world$maxEnergy) - min(world$maxEnergy)
plot(x = world$created, y=world$maxEnergy, main = folder)
points(predation$t, predation$pred_percent*factor + min(world$maxEnergy), type = "l", col="red")

factor = max(world$nkids) - min(world$nkids)
plot(x = world$created, y=world$nkids, main = folder)
points(predation$t, predation$pred_percent*factor + min(world$nkids), type = "l", col="red")

factor = max(world$pgmDeath) - min(world$pgmDeath)
plot(x = world$created, y=world$pgmDeath, main = folder)
points(predation$t, predation$pred_percent*factor + min(world$pgmDeath), type = "l", col="red")

factor = max(world$matForKids) - min(world$matForKids)
plot(x = world$created, y=world$matForKids, main = folder)
points(predation$t, predation$pred_percent*factor + min(world$matForKids), type = "l", col="red")
```

We want to know who eats who




-----

```{r}
# subset
late_interactions = subset(interactions, t>45000 & t<45500)

colors_pred =  rgb(late_interactions$r_pred, late_interactions$g_pred, late_interactions$b_pred, maxColorValue=255)
colors_prey =  rgb(late_interactions$r_prey, late_interactions$g_prey, late_interactions$b_prey, maxColorValue=255)


# plot predators
plot(late_interactions$r_pred, late_interactions$g_pred, col = colors_pred)

plot(late_interactions$g_prey, late_interactions$b_prey, col = colors_prey)

# plot preys as function of predators
plot(late_interactions$r_pred, late_interactions$g_pred, col = colors_prey)

```
